name: 普丽斯卡
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_五_末年上.md:150
who: Priska, a demon-kin woman of the Shadow-cleft valley who teaches letters to the valley's children, thirty-four: tall, about 171 cm, slender and straight-backed. Black hair with a blue sheen, in one long braid hanging over her shoulder on the viewer's right, leaving the other side of her neck bare. On the neck on the viewer's left, from behind the ear to the collarbone, a patch of blue-grey scales that catch a faint pale shine in the light. Pale gold eyes that look very intently at people and at writing. Charcoal grey on her fingers. A small carved wooden tag hangs openly at her throat on a cord; she neither hides it nor wipes it. A calm, focused, patient air.
build: 171 cm, slender and straight, long-limbed and wiry: a B-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips; she can walk for two months without falling behind.
palette: blue-black and pale gold, valley grey linen, blue-grey scale, charcoal
casual: Her teaching clothes: a deep grey homespun linen tunic woven in the valley, over it a worn patched cloak that was her father's, its patches stitched in thread she dyed grey herself; a leather tube holding a scroll of animal hide hangs at her belt; a stick of charcoal in her fingers; the wooden tag in plain view at her throat. She looks at the viewer intently, a patient closed-mouth smile.
private: Home clothes: a soft long-sleeved grey linen dress to the ankles, a knitted shawl, the braid loosened, felt slippers. She stands holding a flat stone with a charcoal letter drawn on it, a quiet, warm smile.
battle: Dressed for a long road: the patched cloak fastened at the throat with the hood down, a leather belt, sturdy walking boots, the leather tube slung on her back. In her right hand a stout walking staff planted before her; her left hand is open at her side.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a teacher standing her ground, the feet planted, one hand holding a stout walking staff in front of her and the other held out flat at her side; a steady, unyielding look, the mouth closed.
formal: A clean deep grey hand-woven linen dress with long sleeves and a soft rolled neck, her father's patched cloak brushed and pinned at the throat, the patches stitched in her own dyed grey thread that sheens faintly, the braid freshly tied with a grey cord, the wooden tag laid outside on her breast. She holds the hide scroll in both hands, a solemn, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly so the blue-grey scales on the neck on the viewer's left show, the pale gold eyes looking straight and intent at the viewer, a small closed-mouth smile. Cold grey valley light from one side and the warm glow of a small lamp from the other. Foreground blur: the stub of a charcoal stick and a few hide-scroll letters. She wears the grey tunic and the wooden tag.

name: 贝托尔德
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_五_末年上.md:206
who: Berthold, a human gatekeeper of the northern gate of the ring of mountains, fifty: tall, about 185 cm, broad, a little stooped from standing in the wind. Short grey-white hair and a short grey-white beard. A face reddened by the northern wind, deep blue eyes that first look at whether a person is standing inside the gate or outside it. Very large hands, the palm of the left one callused from touching two keys every day. A slow, firm, weathered and fair-minded air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man's face of about fifty, wind-reddened cheeks, fine lines at the eyes, a short grey-white beard, deep blue eyes with a steady look, thick grey eyebrows, a broad nose. Skin shadows are a soft warm red-orange.
build: 185 cm, tall and broad, a little stooped: heavy shoulders, big hands, a thick chest; he can push half of a stone door by himself.
palette: wool grey and iron, deep blue, wind red, old leather brown
casual: His gatekeeper's clothes: a thick grey wool robe with a patch of old leather sewn on each shoulder against the wind, belted, a ring of iron keys hanging from the belt with two keys always left hanging, heavy boots. He holds one big key in his left hand, a steady look.
private: Off-duty clothes: a thick knitted wool jumper and plain trousers, felt boots. He stands holding a mug of hot broth in both big hands, a tired, content look.
battle: Dressed to hold a gate: the grey robe belted tight, a leather jerkin over it, the key ring at his belt, a heavy iron-bound wooden gate bar held across the body in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and immovable, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, both hands gripping a heavy iron-bound gate bar across the body; a stern look, the mouth closed.
formal: A clean dark grey wool robe with a brushed collar, the shoulder patches freshly stitched, the two door keys polished and hung on his breast, his hair combed. He stands straight with the hands folded in front, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the deep blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a steady, assessing look, a faint closed-mouth smile. Cold wind-blown daylight from one side and the dim warm glow of a lantern from the other. Foreground blur: blowing snow flakes and the iron ring of a key close to the lens. He wears the grey robe with the leather shoulder patch.

name: 昆提利安
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_五_末年上.md:262
who: Quintilian, a human court attendant who carries messages in the palace of the upper city, forty: medium height, about 176 cm, slender and straight-backed. A pale, clean-shaven long face that gives no hint of his age. Pale gold hair combed perfectly neat. Light violet eyes that look at people evenly, as at a letter not yet opened. Long fingers, nails clipped short. A composed, courteous, careful air.
build: 176 cm, slender and straight: narrow shoulders, long fingers, trained to stand all day without swaying and carry an object the length of a hall without a tremble.
palette: palace white and pale gold, light violet, silver thread, cool grey
casual: His court livery: a long white satin robe with a ring of fire and two crossed keys embroidered at the hem, cuffs folded back one turn, soft white shoes, nothing at his belt. He holds a sealed letter on both palms, a calm, even look.
private: Off-duty clothes: a plain undyed linen shirt and soft grey trousers, the hair slightly undone, felt slippers. He stands holding a cup of warm milk, a rare, small, tired smile.
battle: Dressed for a crisis: the white satin robe tied up at the waist with a plain cord, dark riding trousers beneath, the cuffs bound back, sturdy shoes. He holds a short brass-capped palace staff across his body in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, a courtier braced, the feet apart, both hands holding a short staff across the body; a wary, controlled look, the mouth closed.
formal: The best white satin robe with the ring-of-fire and crossed-keys emblem in cold silver thread at the hem, a stiff ring-shaped collar, a key-shaped clasp, white gloves. He stands with his hands folded, a perfectly composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the light violet eyes looking evenly at the viewer, a faint polite closed-mouth smile. Cold white palace light from one side and a warm gold glow of a candelabra from the other. Foreground blur: a blurred sealed letter held up near the lens and a pillar of pale stone. He wears the white satin robe.

name: 塔尔森
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_五_末年上.md:412
who: Tarson, a human retired standard-bearer of the eastern legion, sixty-two: tall, about 183 cm, lean, with a wide frame whose flesh has fallen away with age but whose bones still hold him up. His right shoulder (on the viewer's left when they face us) sits half an inch lower than the other, from thirty years of carrying a flagstaff. Short grey-white hair and a short grey-white beard. Grey-blue eyes that look first at where a man is standing. A long spear, its shaft cut with many notches, in his hand. A tough, patient, quietly commanding old soldier's air.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old soldier's lean face of about sixty-two, deep lines at the eyes and brow, hollow cheeks, a short grey-white beard, grey-blue eyes with a steady look, thick grey eyebrows. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 183 cm, tall and lean with a wide old frame; big weathered hands, still strong enough to carry a fallen man ten paces.
palette: faded legion grey-blue, bone white, iron, weathered leather brown
casual: His retired standard-bearer's clothes: an old washed-out grey-blue legion cloak with a worn ring-of-fire and crossed-keys emblem embroidered on its back, the thread faded, tied with a standard-bearer's quick-release knot; under it a plain grey wool tunic and trousers, old boots. He holds the long spear upright beside him, the shaft cut with notches.
private: Off-duty clothes: a loose grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, plain trousers, old soft boots, no cloak. He stands with the spear in one hand and rubs his shoulder with the other, a tired, weathered half-smile.
battle: Dressed to hold a line: the old grey-blue cloak tied with the quick-release knot, its faded emblem on the back, a worn legion cuirass with dulled bone-silver rune-lines over the grey tunic, a plain open helm, a round wooden shield on the left arm. He grips the long notched spear in his right hand, held forward at chest height.
formal: The legion cloak brushed and pinned, a clean grey tunic with a plain belt, the old emblem on the cloak back in view, the spear planted upright before him in both hands. He stands very straight, a proud, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the grey-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a level, assessing look, a faint closed-mouth smile. Cold grey dusk light from one side and the warm light of a campfire from the other. Foreground blur: the shaft of the notched spear and drifting sparks. He wears the old cloak with the faded emblem.

name: 玛姬
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_五_末年上.md:468
who: Maggie, a halfling woman cook of a merchant caravan from the honey-wine hills, forty-four: about 108 cm, short, round and sturdy, with forearms thicker than her legs. Reddish-brown curls piled on top of her head and pinned with a wooden spoon. A round face, her nose red from years of cooking fire, her eyes crinkling into slits when she laughs. Many burn scars on both forearms, one overlapping another; she says each one is a coaching inn. A warm, chatty, tough and generous air.
build: 108 cm, small, round and sturdy, with thick strong forearms and thick short hands.
palette: copper red and cream, soot black, apron brown, a little pepper green
casual: Her cook's clothes: a coarse linen apron stained with grease that never washes out, over a brown wool dress with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, her burn-scarred forearms showing; a pouch of salt, a chopping knife and a few heels of dry bread in the apron pocket; a black iron pot strapped on her back, its bottom patched three times, a leather cord tied to its handle. She laughs with her eyes in slits.
private: Home clothes: a loose cream wool dress with long sleeves, a knitted shawl, the curls loosened, felt slippers. She stands holding a steaming bowl of soup in both hands, a contented, sleepy grin.
battle: Dressed to defend the wagons: the apron tied tight, leather gloves, the sleeves rolled, the skirt tied up short, sturdy boots, the black iron pot held up in front of her as a shield, a heavy iron ladle in her other hand raised like a club.
formal: A clean dark red wool dress with a white collar, a fresh white apron over it, her curls pinned up with the polished wooden spoon. She stands up straight with a proud, warm grin.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the eyes crinkled into slits with laughter, a wide warm grin, a ladle of steaming soup lifted near the lens. Warm orange firelight from one side and blue evening light from the other. Foreground blur: rising steam and the rim of a black iron pot. She wears the greasy apron and the wooden spoon in her curls.

name: 茵瑞尔
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_五_末年上.md:524
who: Inriel, an elf archer, a former warden of the eastern woods whose name was struck from the wardens' roll, over three hundred years old but looking about twenty: tall, about 174 cm, thin and long-limbed. Silver-grey hair cut very short, which she cut herself the day she was struck off and never let grow again. Pale green eyes that look at people as if searching for white hairs on them. The tip of her ear on the viewer's left is marked with an old scar. A white line scraped on her left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us), where the bowstring has rubbed for centuries. A calm, watchful, wild air. Her two pointed elf ears do NOT match: the ear on the viewer's left when she faces us lost its very tip to an old wound, so that ear ends in a short, blunt, pale-scarred stub instead of a point and is visibly shorter than the other ear; the ear on the viewer's right is whole, long and sharply pointed. This shorter blunt-tipped ear on the viewer's left is drawn in every panel, the head and the expression sheet.
build: 174 cm, tall and lean, long-limbed: an A-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips; she can crouch motionless in grass all night.
palette: summer forest green and silver-grey, pale green, bow-wood brown, a little cream
casual: Her warden's clothes: a forest-green tunic and trousers in the colour of summer, with a short summer-green cloak and leather bracers, soft boots; a long well-seasoned bow carried in her left hand, a quiver on her back with unmarked arrows, a short knife at her belt whose scabbard has had its carved marks scraped off. A calm, watchful look. The elf ear on the viewer's left is the blunt one, its point lost to the old wound, shorter than the long pointed ear on the viewer's right.
private: Off-duty clothes: a loose summer-green linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, soft trousers, bare feet, no cloak. She stands with the bow held loosely in one hand, looking off to the side, a rare, small, relaxed smile. The elf ear on the viewer's left is the blunt one, its point lost to the old wound, shorter than the long pointed ear on the viewer's right.
battle: Dressed to shoot: the green tunic and cloak tied close, leather bracers and a leather glove on the drawing hand, the quiver at her back. She holds the long bow at full draw, the arrow aimed to the viewer's right. The elf ear on the viewer's left is the blunt one, its point lost to the old wound, shorter than the long pointed ear on the viewer's right.
formal: A long summer-green linen gown with sleeves, a plain leaf-green cloak pinned at the shoulder with a plain brass pin, the cut hair combed, the bow held upright in front of her with both hands. She stands very straight, a quiet, distant look. The elf ear on the viewer's left is the blunt one, its point lost to the old wound, shorter than the long pointed ear on the viewer's right.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale green eyes looking straight and searching at the viewer, a faint closed-mouth smile. Dappled green light from one side and pale gold dawn light from the other. Foreground blur: out-of-focus blades of grass and the tip of an arrow near the lens. She wears the summer-green tunic and cloak. Her ear on the viewer's left ends in a short blunt scarred stub with its point gone; the ear on the viewer's right is long and pointed.
